description: This script is a linter for verifying that function declarations in specific C header files are properly wrapped in version macros, ensuring version consistency in the codebase. It processes preprocessor directives, tracks version blocks, and checks function declarations within extern "C" blocks for correct version macro usage.

classes.name: PreprocessorTracker
classes.description: Helper class to track preprocessor directives and version blocks, maintaining state for conditional compilation blocks in C/C++ code.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data structure representing a lint message, including details like path, line, severity, code, and description.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages (error, warning, advice, disabled).

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Main function to parse a given header file and verify that function declarations are properly versioned.

methods.name: get_current_version
methods.description: Retrieves the current project version from version.txt, used to determine the expected version macro.

methods.name: get_added_lines
methods.description: Determines which lines are newly added or modified in the file based on git diff, to focus checks on recent changes.
